crossRefs.note: I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.
My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.
My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!
My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who…
I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all…
let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.
Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
For his loving kindness is great toward us. Yahweh’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!
Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!

translations.web: My mouth will speak the praise of Yahweh. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.
translations.bsb: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.
translations.kjv: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
translations.asv: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
